text: End of round 1 (19:28 CEST). Made: story model r0 (deep-time frame, protagonist scaffold), story graph, brief and agreement records, author persona Faye Titcombe named and her life registered as its own model (faye-titcombe-life r0). Next, from that model's open questions: rebuild her shocks with change_arc_scaffold so they read as change arcs; model her deepest and learned wants in the construct the tool reads; give Cut-bearing moments places (Swindon, the south-coast university, the payments office, Avebury); add the long developments that enclose her life (the Swindon railway works 1843-1986, the building society and the three-day clearing cycle, the Neolithic landscape of the downs); name concepts (routine as safety, understanding as protection, the band); draw one choice of hers. Then her author model (voice), the author_reader stage, and at least three candidate worlds. Early candidate seeds, not yet chosen: (a) a payments-operations clerk whose job is scam checks, whose white rabbit is a customer who turns the fraud script back on them; (b) twelve words of a recovery phrase found on a paying-in slip, one word per part; (c) the deep-time layers of the Wiltshire downs (Avebury, the Ridgeway, the chalk horse) beside a back-office town, so the Wilson/Harari gap is a landscape the protagonist drives through daily. Pop-culture echoes to weigh: liquid mirror (touching glass to sign), the hidden world behind an ordinary wall, a flood of letters (notifications), the man behind the curtain, the painted sky at the edge of the set, off with their heads (liquidations).
